lesson_applied: No ledger block was served to this seat, so no standing lesson applies. Rule applied: four of five conditions is not a set-up (C3); an unverifiable leg is disclosed, never assumed.
shortfall_reason: Zero nominations, by the method and not for want of effort. The full long set-up (C3/R1) needs cci_20 below the lower reference line on the same bar as the other four conditions. Across every packet row, no cci_20 is below that line; the lowest is SW cci_20 -29.48, and SW fails the trend leg (entry 41.85 under ma_40 43.57). WRBY cci_20 -9.88 is next and fails the odds gate (rs_spy_20d -1.52, C6). Four of five is not a set-up, so no order is armed and nothing is padded in. Separately, the 20MA slope leg and the bar-low-touches-20MA leg are not served for any name, so a complete set-up could not be confirmed even where CCI cooperated. The book is stretched, not pulled back: the names with ma_20 above ma_40 mostly carry cci_20 well over the upper line, which is the extension C3 says never to buy.
